title: Kill Switches, Circuit Breakers, and Canary Tokens

questions.question: What does run_trajectory check before it processes an agent action?
options: The canary path
The action's token cost
The external EXTERNAL_KILL_SWITCH
The next action's payload
questions.explanation: The kill switch is checked first and is outside the agent's control; when enabled, the trajectory breaks before taking another action.

questions.question: When does CircuitBreaker(threshold=5) open for repeated actions?
options: After the first repeated action
Only after a canary is read
When five different actions occur
On the fifth identical action in the recent tail
questions.explanation: record counts an identical tail of five actions; the fifth call changes state to open and returns false.

questions.question: How does a canary read affect the trajectory?
options: It logs the access as an alert but lets the trajectory continue
It permanently opens the circuit breaker
It silently deletes the canary file
It turns off the external kill switch
questions.explanation: Canary.check_read records that a monitored path was read, but the demo continues unless the kill switch or circuit breaker has already stopped it.

questions.question: What is the relevant ordering of controls inside the loop?
options: Canary, action, kill switch, breaker
Kill switch, circuit breaker, then canary check
Action, canary, then breaker
Breaker, canary, then kill switch
questions.explanation: The code first stops for the external kill, then lets the breaker reject an open/repeated pattern, and only then checks a canary read.

questions.question: Why is EXTERNAL_KILL_SWITCH kept outside the Agent object?
options: So the agent can rewrite it after each action
So it applies only to canary paths
So an operator can stop execution through state the agent cannot modify
So it records a fifth repeated action
questions.explanation: The module-level switch is an independent control plane; enabling it causes the next trajectory to break before the agent acts.

questions.question: What does the canary mechanism provide that a circuit breaker does not?
options: A guaranteed rollback of every action
A per-request token budget
A way to edit the agent's tool manifest
A detection signal for access to a monitored path without necessarily stopping the run
questions.explanation: A canary is an observability tripwire. In this demo it logs a read and continues, whereas the breaker stops repeated behavior.
